description: This file defines the ValidationException class used for handling validation errors within the OrangeHRM system's validation module. It extends InvalidArgumentException and includes additional properties and methods for storing and retrieving validation input data and rules.

classes.name: ValidationException
classes.description: A custom exception class for validation failures, allowing storage of input data and validation rules.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the exception with input data, the validation rule, and an optional message.

methods.name: getInput
methods.description: Returns the input data that caused the validation error.

methods.name: setInput
methods.description: Sets the input data associated with the validation error.

methods.name: getRule
methods.description: Retrieves the validation rule that was violated.

methods.name: setRule
methods.description: Sets the validation rule associated with this exception.
